meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 用户要项目历史报告时,Claude 从 claude-mem 取完整时间线,派子代理写一份“Journey Into [项目]”叙事报告并存成 markdown,覆盖起源、架构演进、关键突破等。
howto.when: 当用户要求“timeline report”“journey into [项目]”等报告,或请求梳理完整开发历史时触发。需要 claude-mem worker 运行且有该项目记录。

say.text: 给当前项目写一份 Journey Into 报告
say.note: 将拉取当前项目时间线并生成报告。

say.text: 分析我的项目完整开发史,写份 timeline report
say.note: 会先请求项目名或根据上下文判断。

say.text: 生成完整项目报告并保存为 markdown

howto.what_en: Claude fetches a project's full claude-mem timeline, has a subagent write a 'Journey Into [project]' narrative report, and saves it as markdown including origins, evolution, breakthroughs, debt, and token ROI.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a 'timeline report', 'journey into [project]', project history analysis, or full project report. Requires claude-mem worker running with observations.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into report for the current project
say_en.note: Fetches the project timeline and generates the report.

say_en.text: Analyze my project's development history as a timeline report
say_en.note: Asks for project name or infers it from context.

say_en.text: Generate a full project report and save as markdown
